content: So꞉l eyo꞉ sa꞉so꞉ mogagila꞉len

Ililo꞉ Sitifen sana sowab a꞉no꞉, So꞉l eyo꞉ o꞉li dimidab a꞉la꞉asulo꞉. O꞉g ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ gis kaluwa꞉yo꞉ Ya꞉lusalem Keliso kaluka꞉isalemo꞉wo꞉ hida꞉yo꞉ modo꞉ nolo꞉ mo꞉mo꞉dabiki, tilidabu kaluka꞉isale iyo꞉ dalalelia꞉ga꞉, Yudia hen o꞉lia꞉ Samalia hen o꞉lia꞉ a꞉na ane. Ko꞉sega iliga꞉felo꞉ kalu iyo꞉ mo꞉dalaidaki, Ya꞉lusalem a꞉naka sen.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Godeya꞉ tolo꞉ kudu ha꞉na꞉sen kalu nolba꞉yo꞉ Sitifena꞉ ene do꞉mo꞉wo꞉ dia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, dali alita꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, iyo꞉ ya꞉foda꞉li ha꞉na꞉sio꞉.
Ko꞉sega So꞉l eyo꞉ Ya꞉sulo꞉ kudu ha꞉nab a꞉no꞉ kata꞉foma꞉ki dikidiakiyo꞉, eyo꞉ tilidabu kaluwa꞉ a ka ha꞉na꞉ga꞉, iyo꞉ tililia꞉ga꞉ dibolo aya to꞉lolo꞉.
Filibo꞉ Samalia siliki wido꞉
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ kaluka꞉isale ilo꞉ dalalelia꞉ga꞉lo꞉ ha꞉nab a꞉namio꞉, Godeya꞉ to nafayo꞉ wida꞉li ane.
Filibo꞉ Samalia amisa꞉n a꞉na tina꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godeya꞉lo꞉ Da꞉feyo꞉ Kalu Ya꞉suwo꞉ weka꞉ a꞉la꞉liki fanda wido꞉.
Kaluka꞉isale kegeo꞉ a꞉namilo꞉ sen a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ Filiba꞉ to widakilo꞉ molo ha꞉na꞉no꞉ dimidab a꞉no꞉ ba꞉dakiyo꞉, iliyo꞉ elo꞉ to sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ dinafa dabu.

Filib eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale amilo꞉ mama mogago꞉ dosdo꞉ a꞉no꞉ e o꞉luga꞉felabiki ha꞉na꞉siakiyo꞉, iyo꞉ ganafoda꞉liki ane. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ko꞉go꞉neli kaluka꞉isale o꞉lia꞉ giliga꞉sen kaluka꞉isale o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ modo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ falele alifelo꞉.
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Samalia amisa꞉n kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ sagalo꞉wo꞉ mada alan fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.

Amisa꞉n a꞉namio꞉ kalu imilise nowo꞉ ene wiyo꞉ Saimon ko꞉lo꞉ a꞉na sen. Eyo꞉ fofa ko꞉li ko꞉lilo꞉ dimida꞉labiki, Samalia amisa꞉n kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ molo asula꞉len. E enena꞉ma꞉la꞉ wiyo꞉ duluda꞉liki, misa꞉ kaluwo꞉lo꞉, wa꞉feyo꞉ kaluwo꞉lo꞉ tambo elo꞉ to sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ iligakiyo꞉, “Halaido꞉ Alan, Godelo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉lo꞉ mio꞉ a꞉no꞉ e amio꞉ a꞉lab” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Saimon eyo꞉ fofa man a꞉no꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ ko꞉li ko꞉lilo꞉ wida꞉li ha꞉na꞉labiki, iyo꞉ molo asulaki elo꞉ to sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ iligi dabu.
Ko꞉sega Filib eyo꞉ Godeya꞉ ene kaluka꞉isale ko꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉lab man nafa o꞉lia꞉, Ya꞉su Kelisowa꞉ wi a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ wido꞉ amio꞉, kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ tilida꞉dabiki, iyo꞉ ho꞉na to꞉lolo꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Saimon elo꞉ tilida꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉ dowabiki ho꞉na to꞉lolo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, e Filib o꞉lia꞉ kudu sia꞉la꞉ga꞉, Filib elo꞉ molo ha꞉na꞉no꞉ dimidab a꞉no꞉ ba꞉da꞉ga꞉yo꞉, e molo asulo꞉.
Iliga꞉felo꞉ kalu Ya꞉lusalemdo꞉ sen a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, Samalia kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ Godeya꞉ mano꞉ tilidabuka꞉ a꞉la꞉dabu ko꞉lo꞉, iliyo꞉ Bida o꞉lia꞉ Yo꞉n dia꞉yo꞉ ilo꞉ a꞉na iliga꞉fo꞉.
A꞉la꞉yo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowa꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, i a꞉no꞉ Godeya꞉ Mamayo꞉ dima꞉ki, Godemo꞉wo꞉ dulugu sio꞉.
Mo꞉wo꞉ iyo꞉ Ya꞉suwa꞉ wi amio꞉ ho꞉na to꞉lolo꞉ ko꞉sega, Godeya꞉ Mamayo꞉ i amio꞉ semo꞉mio꞉.
A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Bida o꞉lia꞉ Yo꞉n dia꞉ma꞉yo꞉ dagiyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale amio꞉ golabiki, iyo꞉ Godeya꞉ Mamayo꞉ a꞉na di.

Iliga꞉felo꞉ kaluwa꞉lo꞉ dagiya꞉ golab amilo꞉ Mama ko꞉lo꞉ diab a꞉no꞉ ba꞉da꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Saimon eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉ a꞉no꞉ moleya꞉ kililia꞉no꞉ asulaki, a꞉la꞉mo꞉wo꞉ dabu ba꞉ba꞉, “Gaindo꞉ man dimidab ko aumbo꞉, niyo꞉lo꞉ dagiya꞉yo꞉ kalu nolo꞉ golalikiyo꞉ Mamayo꞉lo꞉ dima꞉ki, halaido꞉ gaindo꞉ ko nelo꞉ dia꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ kililia꞉nigo꞉l.”
Ko꞉sega Bida eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Godeya꞉ boba kelego꞉ we gi moleya꞉ kililia꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉liki asulab ko꞉lo꞉, go꞉no꞉n o꞉lia꞉ mole gilo꞉ a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ de hena soma꞉ni ha꞉na꞉ib.
Gi asulo꞉wo꞉ Godeya꞉ siwa꞉l amio꞉ digalo꞉leyo꞉ mo꞉a꞉lab ko꞉lo꞉, nanog naindo꞉ dio꞉l we, ge o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mada mo꞉ililo꞉.
Mogago꞉ gilo꞉ dimido꞉ a꞉no꞉ ta꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godemo꞉ foga꞉le sama. Giyo꞉ a꞉la꞉dimidalikiyo꞉, Gode eyo꞉ asulo꞉ mogago꞉ gilo꞉ ko ga꞉lila꞉ma꞉iba꞉le a꞉la꞉asulo꞉l.
Mo꞉wo꞉ ge meselo꞉wo꞉ alan dowaki, man mogago꞉ ko꞉lilo꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ge melea꞉fo꞉lab.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Saimon eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Kelego꞉ gaindo꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ ne amio꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowabena꞉kiyo꞉, ne mada gaino꞉ Godemo꞉ dulugu sama.”
A꞉la꞉ma꞉yo꞉ Alana꞉ to o꞉lia꞉ a꞉la꞉mo꞉lo꞉ dimido꞉ o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ malolo꞉ mea꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, a꞉ma꞉la꞉ Ya꞉lusalem ha꞉nakiyo꞉, Samalia amisa꞉n nol amio꞉lo꞉ to nafale a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ wida꞉li ane.
Filib eyo꞉ Itiobia kalumo꞉wo꞉ wido꞉

A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Godeya꞉ ma꞉mul kaluwa꞉yo꞉ Filibo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ge dimidalia꞉ga꞉, kalaleli hen a꞉namio꞉ tog nowo꞉ Ya꞉lusalem a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Gasa amisa꞉n a꞉na ha꞉na꞉sen a꞉lab ko꞉lo꞉, ge a꞉na ti ha꞉na꞉bi.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Filib e tog a꞉na ha꞉na꞉lena, Itiobia kalu nowo꞉ a꞉na yabiki ba꞉ba꞉. Kalu a꞉ma꞉ ito꞉wo꞉ dugula꞉. Kalu a꞉no꞉ Itiobiaya꞉ misa꞉ ka꞉isale, Kandasiya꞉
ene nanogdo꞉ dian kalu alan nowo꞉ e. E Kandasiya꞉ moleyo꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kelego꞉ nafalelo꞉ tambo bo꞉fo꞉lowano꞉ e. E Godeyo꞉ wabuluma꞉niki, Ya꞉lusalem ane ko꞉lo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ ya꞉lena ba꞉ba꞉.

E ho꞉s amilo꞉ i fofodo꞉ wa꞉la siliki, dinali sa꞉lan kalu, Aisaya bugo꞉ a꞉no꞉ halale agela꞉liki mio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, Godeya꞉ Mamaya꞉yo꞉ Filibo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ge elo꞉ yab anidoba꞉da꞉, e o꞉lia꞉ ha꞉na꞉ga꞉ ha꞉na꞉ni hamana.”

A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Filib e nai ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉, i fofodo꞉ ha꞉nab anib a꞉na fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉, kalu a꞉ma꞉lo꞉ dinali sa꞉lan Aisaya bugo꞉ agela꞉i ha꞉nab a꞉no꞉, e dabu. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Filib eyo꞉ kalu o꞉mo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉dabu ba꞉ba꞉, “To gilo꞉ agelo꞉ a꞉no꞉, ge ha꞉go꞉ fanda asulaya?”

A꞉la꞉dabu ba꞉dabiki, kalu a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Kalu noma꞉yo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ mo꞉fanda sa꞉lalega, ne mada mo꞉fanda asuluma꞉no꞉.” A꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Filibo꞉ elo꞉ sab i fofodo꞉ anib wa꞉l a꞉na “Mesa꞉ mena” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Godeya꞉ to ko꞉lo꞉ elo꞉ agelo꞉wo꞉ we,

content.text: “E tililia꞉ mio꞉ a꞉no꞉, sibi sa꞉ma꞉nikilo꞉ tililia꞉ yan o꞉ngo꞉ dimido꞉.
Sibi inso꞉ a꞉no꞉ fo꞉no꞉ gedeab amilo꞉ mo꞉ganagiliano꞉ o꞉ngo꞉ dowaki,
E ma꞉mu iyo꞉ weka꞉ a꞉la꞉bo꞉ mo꞉malola꞉i ha꞉na꞉mela꞉ib,
Mo꞉wo꞉ e henfelo꞉ wenamilo꞉ mela꞉no꞉wo꞉ nolba꞉yo꞉ sanala꞉.”

content: Itiobia kaluwa꞉yo꞉ to a꞉no꞉ agela꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Filibo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉dabu ba꞉ba꞉, “Dinali sa꞉lan kaluwa꞉lo꞉ a꞉la꞉do꞉ sio꞉ we, o꞉b ko꞉lo꞉ sa꞉laigaba꞉le? Eneno꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ sa꞉laba꞉le? O꞉ kalu nowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ sa꞉laba꞉le?”
A꞉la꞉dabu ba꞉dabiki, Filib eyo꞉ Godeya꞉ to a꞉no꞉ mo꞉mo꞉da widakiyo꞉, Ya꞉suwa꞉ to nafa a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ wido꞉.
A꞉la꞉yo꞉ toga ha꞉na꞉la꞉ga꞉, ho꞉ndo꞉wa fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉ Itiobia kaluwa꞉yo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Bo꞉ba! Ho꞉no꞉ we ko꞉lo꞉, gio꞉ ne ho꞉na to꞉loma꞉no꞉wo꞉ o꞉liyo꞉?”
Filib eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ge asulo꞉ amio꞉ hendele tilida꞉dalega, ge ho꞉n amio꞉ o꞉li to꞉loma꞉nigo꞉l.” A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Itiobia kalu eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ya꞉su E Godeya꞉ ene So꞉wa a꞉la꞉bo꞉ ne tili asulo꞉l.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉ e i fofodo꞉ a꞉no꞉ a꞉na kagafoma꞉ki sio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉,
kagayabikiyo꞉, a꞉la꞉yo꞉ ho꞉na tina꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Filib eyo꞉ kalu a꞉no꞉ ho꞉na to꞉lolo꞉.
A꞉la꞉yo꞉ ho꞉na a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ha꞉la꞉ya fa꞉la꞉dowabikiyo꞉, Godeya꞉ Mamaya꞉yo꞉ Filibo꞉ wigibole a꞉naka dia꞉gane ko꞉lo꞉, Itiobia kalu eyo꞉ wa꞉kabiyo꞉ mada mo꞉ba꞉dabiki, e sagala꞉liki ane.
Ko꞉sega Filib e wigibo Asotus amisa꞉n a꞉naka handalowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, e Ya꞉suwa꞉ to nafayo꞉ wida꞉liki, amisa꞉n nolo꞉ ilili alita꞉ga꞉ aneyo꞉, Sesalia amisa꞉n a꞉na fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.

footnotes.text: 8.27 Kandasi a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉, ga amilo꞉ misa꞉ alan dowo꞉ a꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉lan. Ene wileyo꞉ ko꞉li ko꞉lo꞉lab ko꞉sega, Kandasi a꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ sa꞉lakigo꞉l.
8.38 “Kagama” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sio꞉ a꞉no꞉, ho꞉sdo꞉ tililia꞉ ha꞉na꞉len kalu o꞉mo꞉ sio꞉.
